none: PAS NLM-138591: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS [REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 1.93gms, die axis: 6
